syntactic_simplification:
Mice are important in neuroscience research. Scientists can control and study mice. This helps them learn about how the brain works. 

Researchers have often used male mice in experiments. They worry that female mice have hormone cycles. These cycles can change behavior. This might confuse the results.
lexical_simplification:

Researchers often use boy mice in experiments. They worry that girl mice have hormone changes. These changes can change behavior. This might confuse the results.
paraphrase_or_explanation:
Mice are important in brain research. Scientists can control and study mice easily. This helps them learn about how the brain works.

Researchers often use boy mice in their tests. They worry that girl mice have hormone changes. Hormones are tiny chemicals that affect how animals feel and act. These changes can change how the mice behave. This might make it hard to understand the results of the tests.

source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text:
Mice are important in brain research. Scientists can easily control and study mice. This helps them understand how the brain works.

Researchers often use boy mice in their tests. They worry that girl mice have changes in hormones. Hormones are tiny chemicals that affect how animals feel and act. These changes can make the mice behave differently. This might make it hard to understand the test results.
